About

I am a designer
based in Seattle, Washington.

I think of myself as box-shaped, with deep expertise across a few core disciplines and broad knowledge filling in around them. Running through all of it is empathy, a genuine ability to understand the language, constraints, and goals of whoever I'm working with.

I'm the 6th man, the rhythm section. Not always in the spotlight, but reliable enough that teams move faster and work better together because of it. Resilient and adaptable, I move between roles as needed, filling gaps and getting projects across the finish line.

That might mean stepping into strategy, systems, branding, or code, depending on what the team needs most. I see the full picture from concept to execution, and I make sure every detail, visible or not, is in service of the larger vision.

Values

Useful

Clear

Resonant

Lasting

Things I've always cared about and tried to bring to every project. If the work isn't useful, nothing else really matters — but if it's also clear and built to last, that's when it starts to feel right. I love solving a real need with something beautiful. Working with a great team to get there makes it better every time. I try to think big, move fast, and care about the details — always with an eye toward actually helping the people using it.
